edition_check.rules: decision 21: required = section-code and media-code set equality; content = titles, worked examples, exercise labels and seeded samples; build markers recorded, not required; item shortcodes are PDF-only and not compared; no version-string rule

lesson_unit.rule: One numbered teaching section is one lesson (specs/003-curriculum-tracks/decisions.md B). Introductions and chapter summaries are S1 evidence, not lessons, unless promoted.
lesson_unit.provenance_shape: book_provenance = {sections: [{number, title, code}], part: {n, of} | null, chapter_intro: bool, group_key} (FR-4311, decision 18)
